listed_quote.quote: the Fund would be reorganized into the AXS Astoria Inflation Sensitive ETF (ticker: PPI), a series of Investment Managers Series Trust II

announcement.quote: This Special Meeting had been called to ask the shareholders to approve a proposed reorganization of the Fund (the “Proposal”). If approved by shareholders, the Fund would be reorganized into the AXS Astoria Inflation Sensitive ETF (ticker: PPI), a series of Investment Managers Series Trust II (the “Reorganization”).

deals.notes: Target is a series of an open-end trust (a mutual fund series; the acquirer is an ETF). The 425 shows the meeting, originally set for April 11, 2024, adjourned a third time to May 31, 2024 for insufficient shareholder participation; no later filing in the window states the result. Acquirer CIK 1587982 is the 425 filer (Investment Managers Series Trust II); the ETF series itself has no CIK in the header. Target CIK 1318342 is the trust named as subject company.
